display.purpose: Couple's names and section headings only.

body.purpose: Reading text, form fields, info-block copy.

label.purpose: Form field labels and the language toggle — the only place wide tracking is allowed.

shadows.name: seal-raised
shadows.purpose: RSVP submit button only — a physical wax-seal object, not container elevation.

shadows.name: flap-bevel
shadows.purpose: Flip-card countdown units — a beveled metal-edge highlight, not elevation.

components.name: RSVP Seal Button
components.description: Circular primary action button styled as a raised wax seal; carries the couple's monogram.
components.css: .ds-btn-seal { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #d9bb78; color: #3a1420; border: 1px solid rgba(124,87,32,0.5); font-family: 'Bodoni Moda', Didot, Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.875rem; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); transition: filter 0.15s; } .ds-btn-seal:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-seal:active { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-btn-seal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d9bb78; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Language Toggle
components.description: Ghost pill that swaps the whole page between Turkish and English.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: 'EB Garamond', Garamond, Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6b3242; border: 1px solid rgba(169,122,47,0.5); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 12px; background: transparent; transition: color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #3a1420; border-color: #a97a2f; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c5720; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Underline Input
components.description: Text/number field with only a bottom gold rule, no box.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: 'EB Garamond', Garamond, Georgia, serif; } .ds-label { font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6b3242; } .ds-input { background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(169,122,47,0.5); padding: 6px 0; color: #3a1420; font-family: inherit; font-size: 1rem; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-bottom-color: #7c5720; }

components.name: Illuminated Rule
components.description: Signature divider: two gold hairlines fading toward a small diamond-and-dot centerpiece. Placed under every heading and the couple's names; never a filled border.

narrative.overview: The page behaves like an Ottoman nikâh (marriage-certificate) record made luminous for a screen: a legal-ceremonial document, not a greeting card. Every wedding-invitation site defaults to the same move — a full-bleed couple photo under a cursive script overlay, on a pastel wash, corners crowded with generic floral ornament. This world refuses all three. Ground stays pale parchment; the only ornament is a single disciplined gold rule marking names and section breaks, never a filled border or corner flourish; asymmetric negative space is held deliberately rather than centering everything card-on-photo. The world commits to two donated disciplines from outside the wedding-invitation category: restraint in negative space and confinement of all accent color to hairline rules rather than washes. One deliberate contrast beat — a deep-ink, gold-on-parchment section — breaks the otherwise all-parchment scroll at the page's single most important action (RSVP).
keyCharacteristics: Pale parchment ground, disciplined thin gold rule as the only recurring ornament
One deep-ink action beat per page, reserved for the primary call to action
Ceremonial display serif (Bodoni Moda) for names/headlines, warm old-style body serif (EB Garamond) for reading text
Signature interaction: a mechanical flip-card countdown, gold-on-parchment

rules.name: The Hairline Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold never fills a region or forms a closed decorative border. It appears only as a 1px rule, a divider, small structural marks, or text.

rules.name: The One Dark Beat Rule
rules.body: Exactly one section per page reverses to the ink ground — the primary call to action — marking the single moment the reader is asked to act.

rules.name: The Short-Label-Only Tracking Rule
rules.body: Wide letter-spacing (≥0.1em) is reserved for short uppercase labels; sentence-length or italic lines use normal tracking.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Nothing gets a card shadow for being a container. Depth is reserved for the two objects meant to feel physical: the seal button and the flip cards.

dos: Do keep gold confined to rules, borders, and small marks (The Hairline Gold Rule).
Do reserve the ink-dark ground for exactly one action beat per page (The One Dark Beat Rule).
Do self-host display and body faces via next/font/google with latin-ext for full Turkish glyph coverage.
Do theme browser-native surfaces (selection, focus ring, caret, scrollbar) from this palette.
donts: Don't add floral corner ornaments, pastel washes, or a full decorative border.
Don't use a script/cursive display font.
Don't apply wide letter-spacing (≥0.1em) to anything longer than a short uppercase label.
Don't give a content container its own drop shadow.
